reference: Abramson B, Brown J, Edwards W, Murphy A, Winkler RL (1996). "Hailfinder: A Bayesian System for Forecasting Severe Weather." International Journal of Forecasting, 12(1):57–71.
context: Hailfinder is a Bayesian network designed to forecast severe summer hail in northeastern Colorado. Variables are discretized indicators of moisture, vertical motion, cloud cover, instability/capping, synoptic and boundary features, and regional forecast outcomes.

variables.name: N07muVerMo
variables.description: 10.7mu vertical motion; categorical vertical-motion indicator (levels: StrongUp, WeakUp, Neutral, Down).

variables.name: SubjVertMo
variables.description: subjective judgment of vertical motion; human-assessed vertical-motion category (levels: StrongUp, WeakUp, Neutral, Down).

variables.name: QGVertMotion
variables.description: quasigeostrophic vertical motion; QG-based vertical-motion category (levels: StrongUp, WeakUp, Neutral, Down).

variables.name: CombVerMo
variables.description: combined vertical motion; combined/aggregated vertical-motion category (levels: StrongUp, WeakUp, Neutral, Down).

variables.name: AreaMesoALS
variables.description: area of meso-alpha; categorical indicator aligned with the vertical-motion scale used above (levels: StrongUp, WeakUp, Neutral, Down).

variables.name: SatContMoist
variables.description: satellite contribution to moisture; moisture assessment category (levels: VeryWet, Wet, Neutral, Dry).

variables.name: RaoContMoist
variables.description: reading at the forecast center for moisture; moisture assessment category (levels: VeryWet, Wet, Neutral, Dry).

variables.name: CombMoisture
variables.description: combined moisture; combined/aggregated moisture category (levels: VeryWet, Wet, Neutral, Dry).

variables.name: AreaMoDryAir
variables.description: area of moisture and adry air; area-based moisture category (levels: VeryWet, Wet, Neutral, Dry).

variables.name: VISCloudCov
variables.description: visible cloud cover; cloud-cover category from visible observations (levels: Cloudy, PC, Clear).

variables.name: IRCloudCover
variables.description: infrared cloud cover; cloud-cover category from infrared observations (levels: Cloudy, PC, Clear).

variables.name: CombClouds
variables.description: combined cloud cover; combined/aggregated cloud-cover category (levels: Cloudy, PC, Clear).

variables.name: CldShadeOth
variables.description: cloud shading, other; non-convective/other cloud shading category (levels: Cloudy, PC, Clear).

variables.name: AMInstabMt
variables.description: AM instability in the mountains; morning instability category over mountains (levels: None, Weak, Strong).

variables.name: InsInMt
variables.description: instability in the mountains; instability category over mountains (levels: None, Weak, Strong).

variables.name: WndHodograph
variables.description: wind hodograph; wind-profile shape/pattern category (levels: DCVZFavor, StrongWest, Westerly, Other).

variables.name: OutflowFrMt
variables.description: outflow from mountains; categorical outflow strength from mountains (levels: None, Weak, Strong).

variables.name: MorningBound
variables.description: morning boundaries; categorical boundary strength/presence in the morning (levels: None, Weak, Strong).

variables.name: Boundaries
variables.description: boundaries; categorical boundary strength/presence (levels: None, Weak, Strong).

variables.name: CldShadeConv
variables.description: cloud shading, convection; degree of convective cloud shading (levels: None, Some, Marked).

variables.name: CompPlFcst
variables.description: composite plains forecast; composite plains-change category (levels: IncCapDecIns, LittleChange, DecCapIncIns).

variables.name: CapChange
variables.description: capping change; change in capping category (levels: Decreasing, LittleChange, Increasing).

variables.name: LoLevMoistAd
variables.description: low-level moisture advection; low-level moisture-advection category (levels: StrongPos, WeakPos, Neutral, Negative).

variables.name: InsChange
variables.description: instability change; change in instability category (levels: Decreasing, LittleChange, Increasing).

variables.name: MountainFcst
variables.description: mountains (region 1) forecast; categorical forecast outcome (levels: XNIL, SIG, SVR).

variables.name: Date
variables.description: date; seasonal date bucket (levels: May15_Jun14, Jun15_Jul1, Jul2_Jul15, Jul16_Aug10, Aug11_Aug20, Aug20_Sep15).

variables.name: Scenario
variables.description: scenario; scenario identifier/category (levels: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K).

variables.name: ScenRelAMCIN
variables.description: scenario relevant to AM convective inhibition; scenario grouping for AM CIN relevance (levels: AB, CThruK).

variables.name: MorningCIN
variables.description: morning convective inhibition; AM CIN category (levels: None, PartInhibit, Stifling, TotalInhibit).

variables.name: AMCINInScen
variables.description: AM convective inhibition in scenario; AM CIN relative-to-scenario baseline (levels: LessThanAve, Average, MoreThanAve).

variables.name: CapInScen
variables.description: capping withing scenario; capping relative-to-scenario baseline (levels: LessThanAve, Average, MoreThanAve).

variables.name: ScenRelAMIns
variables.description: scenario relevant to AM instability; scenario grouping for AM instability relevance (levels: ABI, CDEJ, F, G, H, K).

variables.name: LIfr12ZDENSd
variables.description: LI from 12Z DEN sounding; lifted-index category from 12Z Denver sounding (levels: LIGt0, N1GtLIGt_4, N5GtLIGt_8, LILt_8).

variables.name: AMDewptCalPl
variables.description: AM dewpoint calculations, plains; morning dewpoint-based category over plains (levels: Instability, Neutral, Stability).

variables.name: AMInsWliScen
variables.description: AM instability within scenario; AM instability relative-to-scenario baseline (levels: LessUnstable, Average, MoreUnstable).

variables.name: InsSclInScen
variables.description: instability scaling within scenario; instability scaling relative-to-scenario baseline (levels: LessUnstable, Average, MoreUnstable).

variables.name: ScenRel34
variables.description: scenario relevant to regions 2/3/4; scenario grouping for regions 2/3/4 relevance (levels: ACEFK, B, D, GJ, HI).

variables.name: LatestCIN
variables.description: latest convective inhibition; latest CIN category (levels: None, PartInhibit, Stifling, TotalInhibit).

variables.name: LLIW
variables.description: LLIW severe weather index; categorical severe-weather index strength (levels: Unfavorable, Weak, Moderate, Strong).

variables.name: CurPropConv
variables.description: current propensity to convection; categorical convection propensity (levels: None, Slight, Moderate, Strong).

variables.name: ScnRelPlFcst
variables.description: scenario relevant to plains forecast; scenario identifier for plains-forecast relevance (levels: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K).

variables.name: PlainsFcst
variables.description: plains forecast; categorical forecast outcome (levels: XNIL, SIG, SVR).

variables.name: N34StarFcst
variables.description: regions 2/3/4 forecast; categorical forecast outcome (levels: XNIL, SIG, SVR).

variables.name: R5Fcst
variables.description: region 5 forecast; categorical forecast outcome (levels: XNIL, SIG, SVR).

variables.name: Dewpoints
variables.description: dewpoints; spatial dewpoint-pattern category (levels: LowEverywhere, LowAtStation, LowSHighN, LowNHighS, LowMtsHighPl, HighEverywher, Other).

variables.name: LowLLapse
variables.description: low-level lapse rate; low-level lapse-rate category (levels: CloseToDryAd, Steep, ModerateOrLe, Stable).

variables.name: MeanRH
variables.description: mean relative humidity; mean RH category (levels: VeryMoist, Average, Dry).

variables.name: MidLLapse
variables.description: mid-level lapse rate; mid-level lapse-rate category (levels: CloseToDryAd, Steep, ModerateOrLe).

variables.name: MvmtFeatures
variables.description: movement of features; movement/feature-evolution category (levels: StrongFront, MarkedUpper, OtherRapid, NoMajor).

variables.name: RHRatio
variables.description: realtive humidity ratio; RH-ratio pattern category (levels: MoistMDryL, DryMMoistL, other).

variables.name: SfcWndShfDis
variables.description: surface wind shifts and discontinuities; surface wind-shift/discontinuity pattern category (levels: DenvCyclone, E_W_N, E_W_S, MovigFtorOt, DryLine, None, Other).

variables.name: SynForcng
variables.description: synoptic forcing; synoptic forcing change category (levels: SigNegative, NegToPos, SigPositive, PosToNeg, LittleChange).

variables.name: TempDis
variables.description: temperature discontinuities; temperature discontinuity category (levels: QStationary, Moving, None, Other).

variables.name: WindAloft
variables.description: wind aloft; upper-level wind-field category (levels: LV, SWQuad, NWQuad, AllElse).

variables.name: WindFieldMt
variables.description: wind fields, mountains; wind-field category over mountains (levels: Westerly, LVorOther).

variables.name: WindFieldPln
variables.description: wind fields, plains; wind-field category over plains (levels: LV, DenvCyclone, LongAnticyc, E_NE, SEquad, WidespdDnsl).
